info.text: Open Care is a directory. It does not give medical advice, diagnose conditions or recommend treatment. In an emergency, call 999.

what.a: A free directory that helps you find hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centers, blood banks and doctors across Bangladesh by name, district and type.

verified.a: Not yet for most records. Listings were imported and some may be incomplete or out of date. A verified badge appears only on records that have been reviewed. Please confirm details by phone before you travel.

booking.q: Can I book an appointment here?
booking.a: Not at the moment. Open Care helps you find and contact a doctor or facility. Booking and other services are planned.

report.q: How do I report a wrong or missing listing?
report.a: Email hello@opencarebd.com with the name of the facility or doctor and what is wrong. If you are the doctor or facility, create an account so we can reach you.

advice.q: Does Open Care give medical advice?
advice.a: No. It is an information directory only. For medical advice see a qualified doctor, and in an emergency call 999.
